title: Hearing on civic education credit for DOE and CUNY students
summary: The Council's Education and Higher Education committees held a joint oversight hearing on the New York State Seal of Civic Readiness, examining how DOE high schools award it and whether CUNY should grant college credit for it. In 2024-2025, 7,855 students across 166 DOE high schools earned the seal, up 72 percent from the prior year. The hearing also covered related bills, including one requiring DOE to distribute dental care information and resolutions urging CUNY and Albany to expand civic education and credit recognition.
